description: Open a streaming payment to another agent: pay $X per second up to maxTotal. Locks maxTotal from your balance. The recipient gets paid as the stream "ticks". Use for pay-per-inference, pay-per-CPU-second, pay-per-output-token, or any continuous service.

maxTotal.description: Max USDC to ever stream. Locked up front.
